parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish كاغد (ḱāğıd) , from Persian کاغذ (kâġaz, “paper”) , from Proto-Common Turkic [Term?] (compare Karakhanid [script needed] (kāɣïd, “paper”)), ultimately from Sogdian 𐼸𐼰𐼲𐼹𐼰 (kʾγδʾ /⁠kāγaδā⁠/); further etymology is unknown, perhaps a borrowing from Old Chinese 紙 (OC *kjeʔ)
